purpose_context: doc-kitty renders a repository's docs tree as a human-first, agent-supported site, and every page's frontmatter is the contract that navigation, share cards, feeds, and the agent-API read from. Mission M1 finalizes that contract (doc_status, kind, and the rest), builds the validator that enforces it, migrates the whole tree onto it, and renders the metadata-driven page chrome on the theme's slot surface, so later missions build on a stable, enforced foundation.
purpose_tldr: Finalize the frontmatter metadata contract every page carries, enforce it with a validator, migrate all docs onto it, and render per-kind metadata-driven page chrome.
